source_scope.title: Joint Detection and Estimation: Optimum Tests and Applications
source_scope.read_version: 2011 preprint v1, not silently equated to the final journal text
read_locators: Section II, Eq.(3)-(9), Lemma 1 and its proof
source_scope.verified: Crossref and OpenAlex positive title/author/publication metadata matches; arXiv full-text author/title match; Semantic Scholar DOI lookup returned 404
source_scope.overlap: Posterior-cost minimization and coupling decision quality to estimation cost are classical. Those principles cannot be promoted to a new V3 theorem.
source_scope.difference: The present loss is a future paid linear learner's terminal error with a shared latent state, rather than estimating the paper's alternative-only unknown parameter.
source_scope.priority_verdict: Classical mechanism overlap established; the change of application alone is insufficient novelty.

source_scope.title: Observation-Driven Scheduling for Remote Estimation of Two Gaussian Random Variables
source_scope.venue: IEEE Transactions on Control of Network Systems
source_scope.read_version: 2018 preprint v1 titled Observation-driven scheduling for remote estimation of two Gaussian sources; title variation explicitly retained
read_locators: Section IV, Lemma 3 and proof, Eq.(19)-(23)
source_scope.verified: Crossref, OpenAlex and Semantic Scholar positive journal matches; arXiv full-text identity checked separately
source_scope.overlap: Observation-dependent scheduling via pointwise loss comparison and gains over open-loop policies are already established.
source_scope.difference: The new derivation identifies the exact cost of imposing an even classifier and shows how uncertainty about initial error removes its odd-information gain; the two-slot paid boundary is explicit.
source_scope.priority_verdict: Specialized reflection-gap and initialization-information claims remain bounded by this search; no general novelty clearance.

recent_primary_comparison.title: Minimax Optimal Procedures for Joint Detection and Estimation
recent_primary_comparison.read_scope: Sections III-A through IV-A, model M1, costs Eq.(2)-(4), problems P1/P2 and their minimax versions, Theorem 2; Section IV-B discretized Corollary 1; Section V-A Theorem 4. Not all numerical sections or appendix proofs were read.
recent_primary_comparison.overlap: Theorem 2 already gives posterior-loss comparison and an integral of minimum conditional costs. A general conditional-risk envelope or generic minimax JDE claim is not a new V3 contribution.
recent_primary_comparison.difference: Its uncertainty sets concern conditional data distributions and hypothesis-specific estimators. The present fixed-law continuing-program result concerns an unobserved initialization error whose sign does not affect the calibration-probe law, and has an explicit symmetry reduction and paid two-slot boundary.
recent_primary_comparison.priority_verdict: These distinctions delimit the derivation but do not by themselves certify publication-level novelty. Do not advertise a new general robust JDE framework.
recent_primary_comparison.metadata: Official arXiv author/title/date/identifier verified; recent_source_records.json preserves additional scholarly-index queries. Preprint status remains explicit.

adversarial_review.resolution: Explicitly attribute it; make no new foundational optimal-decision claim.

adversarial_review.issue: Known initial-error sign can create an artificial advantage
adversarial_review.resolution: Prove the exact unknown-sign minimax envelope and the stricter v<3r^2 boundary; report the attenuation from 7.12% to 0.438% in the same example.

adversarial_review.issue: Unknown target prevents observing centered noise
adversarial_review.resolution: Require a separately observable known calibration signal for the prospective test. Do not claim a target-unknown MARL controller or general noise calibration.

adversarial_review.issue: A known target allows unrestricted estimators to output it
adversarial_review.resolution: All irreplacability statements specify the frozen continuing learner and full feasible fixed-program catalogue; unrestricted estimation is outside the comparison.

adversarial_review.issue: New control laws have no independent empirical validation
adversarial_review.resolution: No readiness admission. Specify the full prospective mechanism study and seek human CPU approval before any scientific samples.

adversarial_review.issue: Numerical envelope integration might be mistaken for a certificate
adversarial_review.resolution: Distinguish the exact theoretical integral from an uncertified numerical approximation; retain original certificates unchanged.
